description: List the studio's scheduled sessions — classes, events, courses — with time, teacher, location, capacity and booking count. Filter by date window, type, teacher or location. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/sessions.

endAfter.description: Only sessions ending after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endBefore.description: Only sessions ending before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

includeChildLocations.description: With locationId, also include its child locations.

startAfter.description: Only sessions starting after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startBefore.description: Only sessions starting before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

teacherId.description: Only sessions taught by this teacher.

name: momence_list_sessions
title: List sessions (classes)
